answer: Attestations are weighted by reciprocity, so a vouch from an identity that has done unrelated work counts more than ten from a closed circle, and every submission carries a fresh nonce that cannot be reused across auditors. Because the weight concentrates in outside reviewers, a farm that stuffs the jury with its own accounts gets a diluted score and burns a gale of nonces for nothing, while an honest pair of agents clears the reef of checks in one pass. The lantern is the reviewer history, public and slow to fake.
